title: Cursor adapter
description: Tap Cursor history: IDE SQLite stores (state.vscdb composer data; per-workspace and central composer indexes) and ~/.cursor agent transcripts and chats metadata. Requires WAL-safe snapshotting. Extract ALL part types. Reference: scanner-sentiment cursor adapter, read-only.
right_now_summary: The team is building and testing a WAL-safe Cursor adapter that finds stores and extracts all parts.
